name: Single-leg hip thrust
summary: Hip extension with the upper back on a sofa; pause at the top.
steps: Sit on the floor with the upper back against the edge of the sofa.
Plant one foot, knee bent, and lift the other leg.
Push through the heel to lift the hips until the body is straight from shoulders to knee.
Pause 1-2 s at the top, lower with control. Switch legs after the set.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back instead of extending the hips.
breathing: Exhale while lifting, inhale while lowering.
harder: Band over the hips, dumbbell on the hip or a longer pause.
contraindications: Lower back pain at the top: reduce the range.

start.alt: Upper back on a sofa, hips low, one foot planted and the other leg raised.

end.alt: Hips lifted level with the shoulders, body straight from shoulders to knee.
